title: Trade Queens to Save the Day
setup: Your queen on d3 is attacked three times, nothing defends it, and every square it could run to is covered.
hint: The queen cannot be saved. Ask what the most valuable thing is that it can take on the way out.
explanation:
## The Idea

The queen on d3 is hit by the queen, the bishop on c4 and the rook on d1, and every retreat lands on a guarded square. It is lost either way, so make White pay the full price. {{Qxe2}} trades it for White's queen, and after {{Bxe2}} you are a piece for a pawn down, but no longer a queen down as well.
